open_points.subject: Model M01 — Project create request id
open_points.text: the request id of its create, as the caller gave it (R0-36; owner, 2026-10-31, State 2 A01)
open_points.question: For an owner-only project creation, what component originates this request id, and is it the idempotency key mentioned elsewhere or a distinct identifier? State 2 A01 is not present in the accepted texts.
options: The owner's browser originates the idempotency key
Registry's owner interface originates the key and has the browser return it
The request id is distinct from the idempotency key
open_points.default_guess: Treat it as the idempotency key, originated by the owner-interface request before the create is submitted.

open_points.text: the request id of its create, as the caller gave it (R0-36; owner, 2026-10-31, State 2 A01)
open_points.question: Who originates the stored request id for each room-creation path—owner interface and agent through Cabinet Kernel—and is it the same idempotency key R0-78 requires for an agent-reachable write?
options: The immediate caller originates one common idempotency-key field: owner interface for owner calls and Kernel for agent calls
The owner or agent principal originates it
The request id and R0-78 idempotency key are separate facts
open_points.default_guess: Use one common idempotency key, originated by the owner interface for owner calls and by Cabinet Kernel for agent calls.
